profile.headline: Author, Speaker & Coach | Co-Author of Mujeres Rising | Guiding Navigations in Identity, Resilience & Major Pivots
profile.summary:
I help individuals and teams navigate major life transitions, build grounded resilience, and live authentically.
My career began with nearly two decades in technology—from running IT operations in the South Bronx and supporting small businesses to spending 13 years at Etsy, where I rose to Staff Software Engineer and led the company’s first automated testing culture initiative. Over that time, I learned how systems, culture, and clarity come together to sustain long-term growth.

In 2019, I came out as a transgender woman, initiated a deep personal shift, and eventually relocated from Brooklyn to Valencia, Spain. Today, as a co-author of the Mujeres Rising anthology, speaker, and coach, I draw on both my lived identity journey and my background in technical leadership to guide people through their own critical pivots.

Core Areas: • Navigating Transition: Practical systems for career pivots, relocation, and life shifts. • Authentic Identity: Grounded self-acceptance, overcoming external expectations, and owning your story. • Shared Operations: Keynotes and workshops on partnership alignment, operational clarity, and sustainable growth.
Reach out directly on LinkedIn or connect at mariaalexishernandez.com

positions.title: Author, Speaker & Coach
positions.description:
Coaching for Radical Self-Acceptance | Transform Doubt into Confidence

My mission as a certified coach is simple yet powerful: guiding people toward profound self-acceptance and lasting personal growth. Having navigated my own journey as a transgender woman, I deeply understand the courage required to embrace your true identity, especially in a world that often challenges authenticity.

From a young age, I knew I was a girl inside, yet circumstances forced me to hide who I was. At sixteen, I courageously shared my truth but was met with disbelief. For years, I attempted to conform to expectations, but the weight of living as someone I wasn't eventually led me back to the undeniable truth I had always known.

After working in the tech industry for two decades, and being laid off (via e-mail) from a role I held for thirteen years, I was confronted with the profound necessity - and the opportunity - to rediscover myself and my purpose. Through this challenging period of transformation and growth, I realized my true calling: empowering others to overcome self-doubt and embrace their genuine selves with compassion and clarity.

Today, I help clients navigate their paths toward radical self-acceptance, turning life's unexpected challenges into powerful opportunities for authenticity and fulfillment. Together, we'll create a supportive space to explore your truths, reclaim your confidence, and experience the joy of living authentically.

If you're ready for a transformative journey toward genuine self-acceptance, let's connect.
positions.insights: Skills: Life Coaching · Confidence Building · LGBTQ+ · Compassion · Empathy

positions.title: Success Coach
positions.description:
Provided specialized coaching to entrepreneurs and business owners struggling with technology fears and digital overwhelm. Guided clients through mindset shifts around technology adoption, helping them build confidence to embrace digital tools essential for business growth.

Coached clients through tech anxiety and limiting beliefs about their ability to master digital platforms
Developed personalized strategies to overcome technology resistance and build digital confidence
Facilitated breakthrough sessions to transform "I can't do tech" mindset into empowered action
Supported clients in navigating complex software implementations with patience and encouragement
Created safe learning environments where clients could explore new technologies without judgment
Helped business owners identify and overcome deeper fears holding them back from tech adoption

This role deepened my understanding of how fear and self-doubt impact personal and professional growth, reinforcing my passion for helping people move past limiting beliefs to achieve their goals.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Started as a 30 year old Junior Engineer, ended as Staff Engineer. Developed and maintained internal support and marketing tools written primarily in PHP. Championed software testing strategy. Mentored new engineers.
positions.insights: Skills: Online Marketing · Training · Linux · Teaching · Web Applications · Mentoring

positions.title: Technician
positions.description: Troubleshoot server & desktop / laptop hardware and software issues for Windows, Mac, and Linux
positions.insights: Skills: Online Marketing · Training · Linux · Teaching · Web Applications

positions.title: IT Lead / Computer Skills Instructor
positions.description: While working at NPRF I served as the IT lead as well as a computer instructor for various programs (AVANCE, LEAP, and more.) I used my passion for putting people first and my tech knowledge to help members of the underserved population in the south Bronx.

volunteerExperiences.description: Taught technology classes to help people work with word processors, improve their online security, and modern music production
